companies.name: AT&T
responsibilities: Designed and developed enterprise backend applications using Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, REST APIs, and Microservices architecture for scalable distributed business workflows.
Developed RESTful web services and reusable API components for communication between React applications, backend Microservices, databases, event-driven services, and external enterprise systems.

Applied object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, design patterns, collections, Java Streams, exception handling, multithreading, and concurrency practices to develop maintainable and performance-sensitive Java components.

Designed Microservices with clear domain boundaries, service-layer abstractions, API contracts, validation, transaction management, centralized exception handling, and integration patterns supporting enterprise application requirements.

Built responsive React.js user interfaces using JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, reusable components, hooks, REST API integrations, form handling, and frontend performance optimization techniques.

Integrated React frontend components with Spring Boot REST APIs, implementing client-side validation, asynchronous API communication, error handling, data transformation, and reusable service modules.

Implemented relational data-access layers using Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, JDBC, PostgreSQL, and SQL while optimizing queries, joins, indexes, transactions, and persistence operations for application performance.
Integrated Java applications with Oracle and PostgreSQL data sources using Hibernate, JPA, JDBC, SQL, and transaction-management patterns to support reliable enterprise data processing.
Developed event-driven integrations using Apache Kafka, producers, consumers, topics, partitions, schemas, and asynchronous message-processing patterns to decouple distributed application workflows.
Designed integration workflows between Spring Boot services and external APIs, implementing request validation, authentication, error handling, retries, timeouts, logging, and defensive processing.
Developed and deployed cloud-based application components using AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, Lambda, CloudWatch, and Kubernetes-based infrastructure.

Containerized Java and frontend application components using Docker and supported Kubernetes deployments, services, configuration, health checks, scaling, rolling updates, and production troubleshooting.

Implemented CI/CD workflows using Git, GitLab, Maven, Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes to automate code integration, builds, unit tests, quality validation, packaging, deployments, and release activities.
Managed source code through Git-based workflows involving branching, pull requests, code reviews, merge management, version control, and collaborative development across engineering teams.

Developed unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito for controllers, services, repositories, utility components, and business logic while improving regression coverage and application reliability.
Performed debugging and performance analysis across Java execution paths, REST API requests, database queries, concurrent operations, frontend interactions, and distributed-service integrations.

Implemented application monitoring and production diagnostics using logs, CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and related observability tools to troubleshoot latency, errors, service health, and resource utilization.

Resolved production defects by reproducing application behavior, reviewing logs and metrics, tracing API interactions, analyzing SQL execution, isolating root causes, implementing fixes, and validating releases.
Participated in architecture reviews, technical design discussions, requirement analysis, code reviews, Sprint planning, backlog refinement, testing, deployment, and production-readiness activities.
Collaborated with frontend engineers, backend developers, QA, DevOps, database administrators, security teams, architects, and product stakeholders to deliver enterprise application enhancements.
Mentored developers through code reviews, debugging sessions, Java and Spring Boot implementation guidance, API design discussions, frontend integration practices, and production troubleshooting.
